lymphosat.name: lymphosat
lymphosat.comment: Winner of the AI generated / AI tuned subtrack (SAT category). Composite solver (126 family-specific solvers and a Kissat-based fallback) selected at run time by the submitted dispatcher; built with the authors' portable generic-build.sh for the dispatcher and the fallback. The family-specific solvers keep the authors' -march=icelake-server flags (some use AVX-512 intrinsics and do not compile otherwise), so on a CPU without AVX-512 the families they cover fail with an illegal instruction and the dispatcher falls back to the Kissat-based fallback, compiled here for generic x86-64 (CC overridden) so that the image answers on any machine. The proof is VeriPB, which satex cannot check, so no argsproof.
